immutable_prior_acceptance_evidence.preservation_check: all hashes unchanged at final pre-commit verification

architecture_prototyped.query_representation: canonical concise scientific intent with bounded target, method, property, application/context, population, and program-form roles
architecture_prototyped.source_representation: deterministic role signatures extracted from authoritative parent title/description, accepted notice facts, controlled program areas, and publication-eligible child title/summary
architecture_prototyped.verification: complete-intent verification over explicit evidence, bounded source relationships, and provenance-backed scope; generic metadata and citation text remain ineligible
architecture_prototyped.rollup: parent/child evidence may aggregate only with a non-generic scientific bridge; cross-topic umbrella-child combinations fail closed
architecture_prototyped.classification: candidate discovery remains separate from primary, broader, and reject states
architecture_prototyped.ranking: existing evidence tiers retained; global field weights unchanged
architecture_prototyped.currentness: search-v2-only fail-closed guard rejects stale undated posted notices older than five years
architecture_prototyped.explanations: Phase-3 causal contract retained; only verified source evidence is explainable

architecture_alternatives_rejected_or_de.broad_or_lexical_admission: rejected because it recreates partial-intent false positives
architecture_alternatives_rejected_or_de.more_program_specific_mappings: stopped because leave-program/family-out results show memorization rather than generalization
architecture_alternatives_rejected_or_de.global_bm25_retune: not run because the fate trace found zero ranking-owned misses
architecture_alternatives_rejected_or_de.ppmi_as_production_semantics: rejected previously; its result is not generalized to modern semantic methods
architecture_alternatives_rejected_or_de.modern_semantic_candidate_benchmark: not triggered because 18/19 parents and all required children were already discovered
architecture_alternatives_rejected_or_de.recommended_architecture_decision: Evaluate a build-time, versioned, provenance-backed source-scope signature generator or source-ingestion enrichment that exposes scientific roles and bounded paraphrases without program-specific query rules. Generated text may aid discovery/interpretation but must not be shown as agency language or independently verify primary relevance.

leave_out_gate.blocking_reason: The fixed challenge sets are perfect, but deliberately untuned relationship families and SCALEUP program scope collapse. This does not support unseen-query generalization and triggers the stop condition against continuing program-specific mappings.

performance_and_size.assessment: Performance remains inside the existing development gate, but latency and architecture size increased materially without passing untuned-family generalization; this reinforces the blocked decision.

final_gate_table.complete_intent_and_broader_separation: passed on spent and fixed development frames
final_gate_table.performance_size: passed existing limits but materially regressed

next_decision: Do not authorize Phase 4C. Choose whether to add a build-time provenance-backed scope-signature generation/ingestion layer and rerun leave-family/program-out development gates. Do not add more query/program mappings merely to perfect spent evidence.
